sections.title: What you will learn to say

blocks.text: So far you talked about now: I am at home. Now you'll learn to talk about the past: «I was at home yesterday», «we were together at Christmas», «there were two clothes pegs in the bag». The clip has a past form for this.

examples.en: I was at home yesterday.
examples.translation: Yesterday, my place was home.

examples.en: We were together at Christmas.
examples.translation: At Christmas, we were in one place.

examples.en: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.
examples.translation: The bag had two pegs in it.

examples.en: Was it warm in spring?
examples.translation: Did spring have warm weather?

blocks.text: The clip has two past forms. Where you used am or is, now use was: I was, she was, it was. Where you used are, now use were: you were, we were, they were.

examples.en: I was at home yesterday.
examples.translation: Yesterday, my place was home.

examples.en: She was in London last year.
examples.translation: Last year, she was in London.

examples.en: We were at home last night.
examples.translation: Last night, we stayed at home.

examples.en: They were in London at New Year.
examples.translation: At New Year, they were in London.

examples.en: The hairdresser was busy yesterday.
examples.translation: Yesterday, the hairdresser had no free time.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday I am at home.
fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.

fixes.wrong: I were at home yesterday.
fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.

fixes.wrong: We was at home last night.
fixes.right: We were at home last night.

drill.why: With we in the past, use were.

sections.title: Past time words: yesterday, last night, on Sunday

blocks.text: Usually there's a word that shows the past: yesterday, last night, last year. For holidays, use at: at Christmas, at New Year. For days, use on: on Sunday.

examples.en: I was at home on Sunday.
examples.translation: Last Sunday, I stayed home.

examples.en: We were together at Christmas.
examples.translation: At Christmas, we were in one place.

examples.en: They were in London at New Year.
examples.translation: At New Year, they were in London.

examples.en: The sports centre was closed yesterday.
examples.translation: Yesterday, the sports centre didn't open.

fixes.wrong: I was at home in Sunday.
fixes.right: I was at home on Sunday.

fixes.wrong: We were together on Christmas.
fixes.right: We were together at Christmas.

blocks.text: For yesterday, use was or were. For now, use is or are, as before. The word yesterday or now tells you which: Yesterday my towel was wet. The shower curtain is dry now.

examples.en: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.
examples.translation: It had water in it yesterday.

examples.en: Yesterday my flip-flops were dirty.
examples.translation: They had dirt on them yesterday.

examples.en: The shower curtain is dry now.
examples.translation: It has no water on it now.

examples.en: The bathroom mirror was dirty yesterday.
examples.translation: It wasn't clean yesterday.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
fixes.right: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my flip-flops was dirty.
fixes.right: Yesterday my flip-flops were dirty.

drill.question: Yesterday the towel was wet. How do you say it?
drill.optionA: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
drill.optionB: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.
drill.explain: Yesterday is the past, so was.

blocks.text: As in lesson 4, things you don't count one by one — cream, food, juice — take the form for one: was, not were. Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.

examples.en: Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.
examples.translation: The cream for the sun was in my bag.

examples.en: The apple juice was cold yesterday.
examples.translation: The juice was cold yesterday.

examples.en: The hot chocolate was too sweet yesterday.
examples.translation: It had too much sugar yesterday.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday the sun cream were in my bag.
fixes.right: Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.

fixes.wrong: The baby food were in the cupboard.
fixes.right: The baby food was in the cupboard.

blocks.text: Put not right after the clip, as always: It was not my day off. The fried egg was not cold. For more than one, use were not.

examples.en: It was not my day off.
examples.translation: That day I had to work.

examples.en: The fried egg was not cold.
examples.translation: The egg was still warm.

examples.en: The peanut butter was not on the table.
examples.translation: It was somewhere else.

fixes.wrong: It not was my day off.
fixes.right: It was not my day off.

fixes.wrong: The fried egg didn't cold.
fixes.right: The fried egg was not cold.

blocks.text: Make questions like in lesson 2: put the clip first. Was it warm in spring? Were you at home in autumn? Short answers use the clip too: Yes, it was. No, it was not. Don't use do or did here.

examples.en: Was it warm in spring?
examples.translation: Did spring have warm weather?

examples.en: Were you at home in autumn?
examples.translation: In autumn, did you stay at home?

examples.en: Was your pancake hot?
examples.translation: Did your pancake feel hot?

examples.en: Were the scrambled eggs hot?
examples.translation: Did the eggs feel hot?

examples.en: Yes, it was.
examples.translation: A short «yes» about one thing.

fixes.wrong: It was warm in spring?
fixes.right: Was it warm in spring?

fixes.wrong: Were your pancake hot?
fixes.right: Was your pancake hot?

fixes.wrong: Yes, it did.
fixes.right: Yes, it was.

drill.prompt: Ask if it was warm in spring.

blocks.text: To say something was somewhere, take there is from lesson 4 and change is to was: There was a towel rail in the bathroom. For more than one thing, use There were: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

examples.en: There was a bed sheet on the bed.
examples.translation: The bed had a sheet on it.

examples.en: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.
examples.translation: The bag had two pegs in it.

examples.en: There was a public toilet near the station.
examples.translation: A toilet for everyone was near the station.

examples.en: There were two taxi drivers near the station.
examples.translation: Two taxi drivers were near the station.

examples.en: There was fruit salad in the bowl.
examples.translation: The bowl had fruit salad in it.

fixes.wrong: There was two clothes pegs in the bag.
fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

fixes.wrong: There are two clothes pegs in the bag yesterday.
fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

drill.after: two duvet covers in the cupboard.
drill.why: There are two covers, so There were.

sections.title: Saying what you thought of something

blocks.text: With was, it's easy to judge something in the past: That was a silly idea. The plan was sensible. For more than one thing, use were: The rules were fair.

examples.en: That was a silly idea.
examples.translation: The idea wasn't clever.

examples.en: The plan was sensible.
examples.translation: The plan was a good, careful one.

examples.en: The rules were fair.
examples.translation: The rules were the same for everyone.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday I am at home.
fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.

fixes.wrong: We was at home last night.
fixes.right: We were at home last night.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
fixes.right: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday the sun cream were in my bag.
fixes.right: Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.

fixes.wrong: There was two clothes pegs in the bag.
fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

fixes.wrong: Yes, it did.
fixes.right: Yes, it was.

fixes.wrong: I was at home in Sunday.
fixes.right: I was at home on Sunday.

blocks.text: All the new grammar in this lesson is two forms: was for I, he, she, it and one thing; were for you, we, they and more than one. Everything else works like am, is, are.
In the past: was or were. Not: was not, were not. Questions: Was…? Were…?, answer: Yes, it was. Something was there: There was / There were. Yesterday: was; now: is.

examples.en: She was in London last year.
examples.translation: Last year, she was in London.

examples.en: It was not my day off.
examples.translation: That day I had to work.

examples.en: Were you at home in autumn?
examples.translation: In autumn, did you stay at home?

examples.en: There was a soap dish next to the washbasin.
examples.translation: A soap dish was by the sink.
